Grok Bot 0.71.2 is out, and this is a very huge upgrade

You can now send files up to 250 MB, and videos up to 1 GB. Full-length clips, raw footage, long recordings, big reports and heavy PDFs can go straight to Grok Bot without compressing, trimming or splitting anything first… pic.twitter.com/pMK7EnMchs

— X Freeze (@XFreeze) October 20, 2026
